title: Bust Out Escape Room
specs: 7 immersive escape rooms at two locations in Albuquerque
Rooms feature a variety of puzzle types and themes
Children under 18 must be accompanied by a parent or adult; for Curse of the Mayan Temple, two adults required
Games suitable for groups of 4-8 players; larger groups (50-200) can be accommodated for team building events
includes: Themed strategic puzzles involving physical props, hidden objects, visual set designs, logical puzzles, teamwork puzzles, and brainteasers
gap: Exact cancellation and refund policy details not stated
blurb: Guests play in private escape rooms solving puzzles and riddles to "escape" within a 60-minute time limit. There are 7 themed rooms across two locations with varying difficulty levels. The experience emphasizes teamwork, communication, and problem-solving skills.
extraNote: All games are private · Arrive 10 minutes early prior to booked time · To add people to booking, call to arrange; additional people pay standard rate onsite
